title: Ranveer Singh's Grandfather Ram Hingorani, His 'Rockstar Nana,' Dies at 96
excerpt: Dr Ram Hingorani died during Lakshmi Puja on Diwali, November 8, his granddaughter Saumya confirmed on Instagram, as the family remembered a man Ranveer once celebrated for voting at 93 in Mumbai's heat.
body:
• Dr Ram Hingorani, Ranveer Singh's maternal grandfather, died at the age of 96 on Diwali, November 8, during Lakshmi Puja.
  • His granddaughter Saumya, Ranveer's cousin, shared the news on Instagram on Tuesday, according to reports in Hindustan Times and the Free Press Journal.
  • The family remembered him as a 'rockstar' who lived a glorious life, choosing to celebrate his long life as they announced his peaceful passing.
  • Ranveer had given his grandfather the 'Rockstar Nana' name himself in 2024, after the then 93-year-old stepped out in Mumbai's heat to vote in the Lok Sabha elections.

Dr Ram Hingorani, the maternal grandfather of actor Ranveer Singh, has died at the age of 96. He passed away on Diwali, November 8, during Lakshmi Puja, according to reports of the family's announcement published on Tuesday. The news was shared on Instagram by his granddaughter Saumya, Ranveer's cousin, who confirmed that he had peacefully left the family on Diwali, the Free Press Journal reported.

Rather than an announcement framed only in grief, the family's tribute celebrated the life he had lived. Hindustan Times reported that his cousin remembered him as a 'rockstar' who lived a glorious life — a description that will be familiar to anyone who followed Ranveer's own posts about his grandfather. The reports did not give a cause of death, and Ranveer himself had not issued a separate public statement in the coverage published on Tuesday.

The 'Rockstar Nana' the public came to know

Most fans met Dr Hingorani through his grandson's social media. During the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Ranveer shared a photograph of his 93-year-old grandfather at a Mumbai polling station, where he had stepped out despite the summer heat, wearing a shirt, trousers and sunglasses and helped by a policeman, and voted.

"93yrs old. 93°F outside. But he voted. He's a voter! My Rockstar Nana."

— Ranveer Singh, Instagram, May 2024

The post, reported at the time by ANI, fixed the 'Rockstar Nana' name in the public mind. A year earlier, during the celebrations for Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani in 2023, Ranveer had shared videos of his grandfather dancing to 'Jhumka Gira Re', the classic song recreated in the film — another glimpse of the energy the family kept returning to in its tributes this week.

A farewell on the family's biggest festival day

That he died on Diwali, during Lakshmi Puja, is the detail the family itself chose to underline: Saumya's announcement described a peaceful departure in the middle of the festival, and relatives chose to mark a 96-year life as a glorious one. For a family that had shared him with the public only in moments of evident delight — dancing at a film celebration, voting at 93 — the farewell kept the same tone.

Ranveer Singh, who was born Ranveer Singh Bhavnani, is the son of Jagjit Singh Bhavnani and Anju Bhavnani; Dr Hingorani was his mother's father. No funeral or memorial details were included in the reports published on Tuesday.
